title: Hip Flexibility Test
texts:
After a sufficient warm-up, walk your feet out to the widest box split or side split stance possible.  You must be able to get in and out of this position without external support.  Once in the widest position possible, use a tape measurer placed on the floor or a partner to measure the distance between the inside edge of both heels.  

As you get lower to the ground, allow your hips to move back behind your heels while maintaining an anterior pelvic tilt (arched low back with chest up).  This rotation will create the appropriate space between your pelvis and hip bones allowing you to reach your maximum distance.  You may choose to rotate your toes outward depending on comfort and stability.

Upon completion, log the workout and record the total distance.
